summary: Remote full-stack role on care-sector platforms, working directly with Australian stakeholders every day.
highlights: Maintain and extend a live care-sector support-worker allocation platform serving 50+ organizations, 300+ clinicians, and 2,000+ users, matching support workers to clients by skill, location, and availability.
Took ownership of an inherited production codebase after a one-month handover; independently resolved 150+ production issues and ship hotfixes directly to the client, from code change to deployment.
Removed the platform's dependency on Salesforce by rebuilding the core service-validation logic from scratch and moving live operations onto the in-house Django and PostgreSQL system.
Led scripted data migrations of ~8,000 records to staging and ~14,000 to production, using a custom dry-run comparison script and 5+ validation stages to block duplicates, with zero data loss.
Optimized PostgreSQL queries and API logic in the service-creation workflow, reducing a long-loading process to completion within seconds.
Fixed a cross-timezone scheduling defect so appointments display in each service's own time zone rather than the viewer's device time.
Work directly with Australian stakeholders every day on requirements gathering and live support, and partner with the client's Salesforce developer to plan and execute the migration.
**Therapy-scheduling platform (React, Node.js):** resolved production bugs and built a feature that lets clients move into another therapy session even after their own session has started.
**Online exam portal:** set up the initial code architecture and built the frontend over the first 6+ months, from project start through mid-phase, including automated grading and real-time results.

summary: Shipped 4+ offline-first React Native apps for 2,000+ field technicians.
highlights: Delivered 4+ production mobile apps used by 2,000+ field technicians, with Redux Toolkit managing state across the app suite.
Designed an offline-first sync architecture (SQLite, AsyncStorage, custom retry queues with exponential backoff), raising sync success in low-connectivity areas from ~30% to ~80%.
Refactored legacy components and automated media compression, cutting UI latency by 30% and image payloads by 60%.
Led 15+ Android and iOS releases through App Store and Play Store review cycles, including encrypted local storage and compliance checks.
Also built a customer visit-management app (photo capture, signature pad, real-time sync) and a GPS-aware attendance app with QR check-in and offline logging.
